notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome) succeeded for homepage, all collection pages, robots.txt and sitemap.xml - fully SSR/static HTML with server-rendered product-list totals, no escalation to Playwright/Chrome needed. robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-ai disallow (generic Shopify robots.txt), only blocks admin/cart/checkout/search paths - not relevant to any tier used. TREE: built union of mega-menu (7 top nav sections: Garden, Furniture, Accessories, Kitchen & Dining, Bedroom, Bathroom, Hardware, Lighting) + sitemap_collections_1.xml (~150 collection URLs) + each leaf collection's own breadcrumb (none had further sub-nav - all leaves are flat under their parent menu section). Cross-checked h1 on every recorded leaf against requested slug - all matched. Non-nav sitemap collections (seasonal/marketing pages like linen-edit, spring-linens, cushions-to-comfort, woven-wonders, declutter/'A Place for Everything', summer-textiles, our-patchwork-edit, etc.) excluded per View-All/Collection/Promotional rule (textile.md 27, storage.md 35) since they are not part of the structural mega-menu or breadcrumb hierarchy. QTY: exact rendered 'N products' text from data-external-el="product-list.total" span on each collection page (real DOM count, not the Storefront API 'first:250' query string which is unrelated boilerplate). EXCLUDED: Furniture > Storage & Shelving (20 products - inspected product hrefs: bedside tables, chests of drawers, coat stand, side/console tables, dresser, sideboard, bookshelf, wall/bathroom shelves, hallway storage bench - overwhelmingly furniture pieces explicitly under the Furniture menu; per storage.md Sec21/27 prefer Furniture when site places it in Furniture nav - out of scope, Furniture.xlsx already validated separately). Kitchen & Dining > Kitchen Storage (13 products - inspected: drinks trolleys, console table, sideboard, dresser, bookshelf, hook/hanging rails, and only 2 of 13 are genuine storage jars) - primary product type of this node is furniture/hardware, not storage, so the category node itself was not recorded as Storage (primary-product-type test, storage.md ambiguity handling Sec42). Mirrors, Candlelight, Lampshades, Decorative Accessories, Handmade Ceramics (Accessories) = Decorative/Lighting, not Textile/Storage. Tableware, Glassware, Dining Furniture (Kitchen & Dining) = Kitchen & Dining/Furniture, excluded. Beds, Bedroom Furniture = Furniture, excluded. Bathroom Fittings, Bathroom Mirrors, Bathroom Accessories = Bathroom fixtures/decor, not textile, excluded (Bathroom Textiles kept). Hardware section (Knobs & Handles, Latches, Interior Door Handles, Front Door Furniture, Hooks & Rails) = hardware, neither category. Lighting section = Lighting, excluded. Garden Furniture/Seating/Tables/Accessories/Potting & Planting/Outdoor Lighting = Furniture/Lighting/Garden decor, excluded; Garden Cushions kept as Textile (verified product hrefs are fabric cushions/seat pads for garden furniture, textile.md Sec12 outdoor textiles). No Storage rows qualified - storage_rows is empty, a valid correct answer per brief.
